diff --git a/openlibrary/plugins/openlibrary/tests/test_lists.py b/openlibrary/plugins/openlibrary/tests/test_lists.py
index a282c36..dabf9c5 100644
--- a/openlibrary/plugins/openlibrary/tests/test_lists.py
+++ b/openlibrary/plugins/openlibrary/tests/test_lists.py
@@ -1,3 +1,5 @@
+import web
+
 from openlibrary.plugins.openlibrary import lists
 
 
@@ -11,3 +13,40 @@ def test_process_seeds():
     assert f({"key": "/books/OL1M"}) == {"key": "/books/OL1M"}
     assert f("/subjects/love") == "subject:love"
     assert f("subject:love") == "subject:love"
+
+
+def test_list_record_from_post_body_ignores_query(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        web,
+        'data',
+        lambda: (
+            b'name=Body+name&name=Second+name&description=Body+description'
+            b'&seeds--0--key=%2Fbooks%2FOL1M&seeds--1--key='
+            b'&seeds--2--other=bad&seeds--3--key=%2Fsubjects%2Flove'
+        ),
+    )
+
+    def unexpected_input(**defaults):
+        raise AssertionError('POST body must not be merged with query parameters')
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', unexpected_input)
+
+    record = lists.ListRecord.from_input()
+    assert record.key is None
+    assert record.name == 'Body name'
+    assert record.description == 'Body description'
+    assert record.seeds == [{'key': '/books/OL1M'}, 'love']
+
+
+def test_list_record_from_query_without_body(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'data', lambda: b'')
+
+    def query_input(**defaults):
+        return web.storage({**defaults, 'name': 'Query name', 'seeds': ['OL1M']})
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(web, 'input', query_input)
+
+    record = lists.ListRecord.from_input()
+    assert record.name == 'Query name'
+    assert record.description == ''
+    assert record.seeds == [{'key': '/books/OL1M'}]
